written: 2026-10-03, BEFORE any correlation in the research window was computed; only instrument first-bar dates were looked at
data: daily log returns (close-to-close, last price) via the research door, 2023-01-01 .. 2025-09-30 (holdout sealed); pairwise-complete timestamps, nothing filled; min_overlap 60
universe_rule: every stored instrument whose first daily bar is before the holdout start; CL, MU, SNDK, NIGHT, ZEC are excluded by that rule (they list inside the holdout)
survivorship: SURVIVORS ONLY: the universe is today's turnover top-N plus archived names; instruments delisted before 2026 (e.g. LUNA, FTT) are absent, so measured co-movement is that of survivors and likely understates crash co-movement

expectations.E1: median over crypto alts (all instruments except BTC and XAU) of full-window rho(alt, BTC) >= 0.60
expectations.E2: at cut distance 0.5 (average-linkage, distance 1 - rho) all eight full_history_set instruments sit in ONE cluster
expectations.E3: XAU is outside the crypto cluster at cut 0.5 and rho(XAU, BTC) < 0.30
expectations.E4: STRESS: in BTC's worst calendar month of the window (lowest close-to-close month return, chosen mechanically), the mean pairwise rho of the full_history_set is >= its full-window mean pairwise rho (diversification shrinks when it is needed)

report_only: rolling 90-day rho(alt, BTC) per alt: min, max, and the dates of the min
per-pair overlap counts (short-history names HYPE, TRUMP, PUMP, XAU, PEPE, SUI, WLD)
cluster structure at cut 0.5 within the worst month
consequence: each expectation is PASS/FAIL as written; a FAIL is reported and kept, not re-specified. This is a demonstration for the RC-07 cluster-exposure design (M5), not a gate
